newsitem.title: USA: HCC and AVEMCO sign definitive merger agreement.
newsitem.headline: HCC and AVEMCO sign definitive merger agreement.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc and AVEMCO Corp said Friday that the companies had signed a definitive agreement for their merger, announced Jan 17.
The companies also said that as part of the agreement, AVEMCO will not declare a dividend on its common stock. Its latest quarterly dividend was $0.12 per share.
The companies said under the agreement, one share of AVEMCO common stock will be exchanged for one share of HCC stock. The deal is valued at $230 million.
The companies also said that William Condon, chief executive officer of AVEMCO, will leave that post March 1, staying on as chairman of the board until the merger is consummated.
He will be succeeded as CEO by John Shettle, who currently serves as president and will retain that title, said the companies.
HCC is a specialty insurance group. AVEMCO underwrites insurance primarily for small and medium-sized aircraft.
